Whether you're in Windsor, Mississauga, Brampton or any Ontario city, we'll help you find verified bin stores near you with current store hours, daily pricing schedules, and exact locations. How Ontario Bin Stores Work: The Weekly Pricing Model Bin stores in Ontario offer incredible savings on brand-name merchandise. These stores purchase overstock inventory, Amazon returns, and liquidated items from major retailers like Target, Walmart, and Home Depot, then pass massive discounts to shoppers. Items typically start at higher prices ($30) on restock days and drop daily until reaching as low as $0.99 by the end of the week. From electronics and home goods to clothing, toys, furniture, and household essentials, Ontario's 41 bin stores offer treasure-hunt shopping experiences where you can save 50-90% off retail prices. Most stores follow a weekly pricing model, restock on specific days (usually Saturday), and maintain active Facebook pages with updates.
